questions: Can a bucket be used to extract water from multiple wells in a single operation, or must each operation lower a bucket into exactly one well?
If a bucket is partially filled from a well, can it be used to extract water from another well in the same operation to fill it to capacity?
Does each well have its own dedicated bucket, or is there a single bucket that can be used across wells?
Is the bucket emptied after each lowering operation, or can it retain water across operations?
Must all water from a well be extracted consecutively, or can we interleave operations across wells arbitrarily?
Is the goal to minimize the number of operations, or is there a fixed procedure (e.g., always fully fill bucket when possible)?
Are there any constraints on the order of operations, such as needing to empty one well completely before moving to another?
Does 'lower the buckets' mean one bucket per well per operation, or can multiple buckets be lowered simultaneously in one operation?
